message: The other night, I was whipping up dinner and felt that rush of confidence—until my phone suddenly died. No timer for my roast chicken, and I could only hope my smoke alarm wouldn’t have to make an appearance. It reminded me how important it is to have a backup plan, whether it’s a good old-fashioned kitchen timer or a buddy system for fire safety. It’s funny how the little things can slip your mind until you really need them! 🔥
